Refs -> aha-resuscitation, openstax-medsurg, openstax-pharm (dropped dailymed). EHR timing (2 g started 10:00, 40% at 10:12) and pre-existing fever/WBC consistent.

o1 asked for findings 'requiring immediate follow-up' but keyed 2 mm pupils, an expected opioid effect that is not itself an emergency (arguable key); stem changed to 'consistent with opioid toxicity' and rationale adjusted. Refs -> ismp-highalert, aha-resuscitation, openstax-pharm. PCA math verified (18 x 0.2 mg = 3.6 mg; max 27 doses in 4.5 h at 10-min lockout); naloxone 0.04 mg titration order and 0.12 mg total consistent.

w2 keyed CIWA-Ar 18 as 'severe' but severity cutoffs vary (>15 vs >20); key changed to 'significant withdrawal that needs medication' and rationale explains the varying cutoffs. w3 rationale said seizures are most likely 24-48 h; corrected to 6-48 h with DTs at 48-96 h. Timeline (last drink 09:00 yesterday -> ~36 h), Mg, MCV, AST:ALT >2 consistent.
